notes.title: Patch 1.1.0
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Removed prompt on new game giving players the option to turn music on: music now defaults to on for new players
[*] Enabled subtitles on/off toggle in Settings (located in the Gameplay section)
[*] Fixed issue in sauna puzzle occasionally preventing players from progressing
[*] Fixed issue with the vacuum preventing player progress unless they reloaded their save
[*] Fixed issue in the Dining Room so mannequins cannot eject players from the level
[*] Fixed issue where players were unable to open "The Bargain" book when saving or loading after opening it
[*] Fixed issue where UV Flashlight could cause the incorrect music to play near the end of the game
[*] Tweaked settings to allow Intel XeFG (Frame Generation) on Non Intel ARC GPUs
[*] Fixed issue causing FSR3 (Frame Generation) to not appear in upscaler menu
[*] Allowed FSR3 FG (Frame Generation) on non AMD GPUs
[*] Shader caching improvements
[*] Tweaked presets for new users to set better default graphics settings
[*] Fixed rare potential issue with Steam overlay hang


Please note: Switching Frame Generation backends requires setting the Frame Generation mode to “Off” and then restarting the game. You will then be able to set applicable choices for frame generation. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[p]
 Point of No Return improvements:
[/p][olist][*][p]Some players reported wanting to be able to reload before the point of no return in order to explore the mansion a bit more and hunt for achievements.
[/p][/*][*][p]We’ve added the ability for people that have completed the game to continue their Save from the point before the point of no return, meaning you will be at a point where you can explore the Mansion and re-watch videos in the Cinema. [/p][/*][*][p]Please be aware that if you hit the point of no return, you need to play right the way through to the end of the game and then hit ‘continue’ from the main menu to be put back into the mansion. This will work on existing save games.
[/p][/*][/olist][p]
[/p][list][*][p] Disabled Nvidia Image Scaling on GTX 10 series cards because it causes a crash on certain driver versions.
[/p][/*][*][p] Added translations for first boot music on/off prompt (Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean)
[/p][/*][*][p] Added a very faint light in one darker late-game environment to help players navigate better
[/p][/*][*][p] Audio bug fixes
[/p][/*][*][p] Cinema knocking door bug
[/p][/*][*][p] Chase’s glitchy audio bug
[/p][/*][*][p] Cinema speaker bug
[/p][/*][*][p] Front gate area bugs
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where the cursor is not centred when you first interact with an object using controller
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where head of Poseidon’s trident in the Spa can move out of place after the puzzle is solved and the player revisits the Spa later in the game
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where voice note subtitles do not pause when the game is unfocused
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where mouse cursor not visible when entering numbers for the key fob in the security hut
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where item can be picked up while the draw is moving
[/p][/*][*][p] Fix for benchmark only running on one platform due to sync
[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed issue where the sticky note in security hut can vanish after reading but is still interactable
[/p][/*][*][p] Improvement to match Art Book and Inventory controls and UI
[/p][/*][*][p] Potential fix for issue where the black screen at intro remains over the game[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5
notes.content: [list][*][p][b]Added a prompt on starting a new game giving players the option to turn music on[/b] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We've turned music off by default due to a content ID error that's causing copyright strikes on platforms like Twitch and YouTube. [/p][p][/p][p]That way, anyone who wants to play with music can easily turn it on while players streaming or capturing for Twitch/YouTube won't have their videos muted or demonetised. [/p][p][/p][p]When this issue is resolved, we'll turn music back on by default. YouTube is already fixed, so we're well on our way! Twitch is next. [/p][p][/p][p]If you've had a video muted or demonetised, please send a message with a link to the affected video(s) to [url="https://support@surgentstudios.com"]support@surgentstudios.com[/url].   [/p][p][/p][h3]Dead Take Official Streaming Permission [/h3][p]You have full permission to stream, record, and monetise videos of Dead Take, including all in-game music. [/p][p]We are the creators and rights holders of the soundtrack. If you receive a copyright claim or muted content notice (e.g. on YouTube or Twitch), it is likely due to automatic detection through music fingerprinting services. [/p][p]We are in the process of removing the soundtrack from all such systems so this will not happen in the future.  [/p][p]In the meantime, you may dispute the claim citing the following: “I have permission from the rights holder to use this music.” [/p][p]You can also include the URL for this post as part of your verification. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support! We are so appreciative of your streams and videos.  [/p][p][/p][p]-The Surgent Team[/p]

tags.feature: [b]Added a prompt on starting a new game giving players the option to turn music on[/b]
